footnote_text: Grant of restricted stock units ("RSUs") under the Issuer's 2022 Equity Incentive Plan, as amended. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of common stock of the Issuer. The RSUs were granted on November 11, 2026 and will vest in equal installments on each of July 15, 2027, 2028, 2029 and 2030, subject to the reporting person's continued service with the company. || Includes 18,400 unvested RSUs.
